rows.scavenge-cost-is-the-mana-cost: CR 702.1a: with Varolz on the battlefield, a creature card in its controller's graveyard has scavenge at its mana cost, so Grizzly Bears can be scavenged for {1}{G}. Observed: no activation was offered for the Bears in the graveyard (the priority options were only pass and concede).
